job.title: Senior Software Engineer - .Net/AWS
job.description:
Build real-time, event-driven .NET Microservices as a Senior .NET Engineer.
  • Rate: $950 per day
  • Location: Melbourne CBD, hybrid (most of the team is in 2 days a week)
  • The good stuff: Solve real business problems, not just close tickets
About the opportunity:

Fancy getting your hands on the real-time systems behind a busy, well established online business? This team has great products, plenty of traffic and an event-driven platform that keeps it all humming.

As a Senior .NET Engineer you'll design and ship .NET Core microservices that chat to each other through event streams. You'll work alongside product, data, cloud and architecture folks to figure out what actually moves the needle for the business. Experience in a similar online or high-traffic environment will help you hit the ground running.

The role:
  • Design and build C# / .NET Core microservices in an event-driven architecture
  • Build services on AWS that stay up and scale when traffic spikes
  • Own what you ship: testing, CI/CD and keeping it healthy in production
  • Shape solutions with the Technical Lead and keep them documented and easy to support
  • Share what you know and help lift the bar for the wider engineering team
What you'll bring:
  • 7+ years of commercial C# / .NET Core development
  • Hands-on Kafka (or similar streaming tech)
  • Solid event-driven design and microservices architecture experience
  • AWS know-how across VPC, EC2, ECS, RDS, CloudFormation and CloudWatch
  • AI experience 
Bonus points for RabbitMQ, NUnit and test automation, Docker / Jenkins / Ansible, using AI tools day to day in development, or an AWS certification.

The team and culture
  • Humble, curious people who like learning fast
  • Problem solvers who chase the real outcome, not just the task
  • Agile, iterative delivery focused on adding value
  • Everyone owns their work and backs each other up
What's on offer
  • 12-month contract
  • Start ASAP, or after a 2-week notice period
  • Hybrid: officially 3 days in the Melbourne CBD office, though most of the team does 2
Sound like you?

If you've got full working rights and you're based in Melbourne, we'd love to hear from you. Hit apply and let's have a chat!

job.title: Recruitment Specialist - Sydney
job.description:
Recruitment Specialist - Sydney
  
WHO IS PRA?   

PRA is a leading Digital & IT Recruitment company with offices in Brisbane, Sydney, Canberra and Melbourne.
  
PRA offers all its employees’ industry leading financial incentives, flexible working arrangements, training and genuine career growth in Sydney and interstate.
 
Some of the key benefits are;

  • High financial rewards with commission up to 50%
  • Cloud based technology, so you can work from home or on the move
  • External / Internal training and continuous improvement programs
  • Career opportunities into management
  • Work Perks such as up to 25 days leave per year, team events, lunch clubs, sales comps and many more.  
  
What is the role?   
Working out of our very cool Sydney office, you will build your own accounts and networks. We will help you to develop your business and ensure your success as a best in class recruitment and technology professional.

You are able to work on both contract and permanent roles and you can build up significant revenue streams whilst placing permanent candidates. 

We have multiple positions available, such as:
  • Candidate Manager 
  • Associate Consultatant
  • Recruitment Consultant
  • Senior Consultant
  • Managing Consultant
  • Principal Consultant
  • Client Services Manager   
Consultants within PRA are responsible to develop long term relationships with clients and to offer a professional and effective service to clients and candidates.  Delivery and the style of the delivery are paramount to maintain and develop the image of PRA as a leading supplier of recruitment solutions.
What will you do?
  • Selling and promoting PRA’s services to existing and new customers
  • Expanding PRA’s reach within each customer through business development activities
  • Managing and maintaining client accounts for PRA’s services through consistent communication and client visits
  • Assessing clients’ needs and providing services and solutions that satisfy client requirements
  • Co-ordinating with PRA’s internal resources to ensure customers receive best in class service
  • Providing timely and regular reporting to both internal and external stakeholders
  • Utilising market knowledge to pitch new clients and win new business
  • Dealing with clients & candidates, developing long term effective relationships
  • Negotiating rates with clients, both contract and permanent
  • Giving presentations to clients
  • Handling clients and applicants through recruitment process to successful conclusion
  • Writing advertisement copy
  • Selection of applicants for vacancies
  • Interviewing applicants
  • Arranging interviews with clients and candidates
  • Ensuring contact is made on a regular basis with contractors once placed out on the client’s site
  • Maintaining awareness of trends within area of technical specialisation
  • Ensuring that contact is made with clients on a regular basis and updating the database
What kind of person thrives in the PRA environment?   

Communication and people management are the defining elements of this role.  To perform it successfully, a candidate will need to be confident, and possess the ability to inform and persuade others and effectively present both themselves and the organisation they represent.  Friendliness and charisma are important factors in performing such a job effectively, together with the ability to put others at their ease.

Attention to detail, responsiveness and adaptability are also key elements in this job.  You will have energy and enthusiasm, and the ability to deal confidently with changes in work environments and situations.  The job often calls for work to meet deadlines or be completed within short timescales, and the ideal candidates will be prepared to commit themselves if they are to succeed.

Recruitment is challenging and fast-moving, and there are times you will practice patience to see through a difficult time or a minor repetitive task.  Having said this, you will see that these periods as necessary to your personal advancement and will contribute to your own goals in life, and in return you will work towards a career that is rewarding and flexible!
What will you have done before?   
  • Min 2 years experience working with a range of stakeholders within the recruitment industry
  • Excellent communication skills, both written & verbal
  • Working autonomously & within a team, doing everything in your power to ensure your colleagues success as well as your own- recognising that the greater teams’ success will always benefit you personally
  • Attention to detail and an enjoyment of being busy; managing multiple moving pieces at one time
  • Min 2 years experience in a Business Development capacity
This role attracts a Base salary of $89,000- $100,000 Pkg+ OTE  

Apply now for immediate consideration

job.title: Technical Design Manager - Venues & Major Infrastructure
job.description:
About the Role
We're looking for a Technical Design Manager - Venues & Major Infrastructure to lead complex technology projects across ICT, audiovisual (AV), security, digital infrastructure and venue technology. 
 
You'll guide projects from initial requirements and programming through design, documentation, construction, commissioning and handover. Working closely with clients, consultants, vendors, contractors and technical teams, you'll bring people and disciplines together to deliver coordinated, practical technology solutions. 
 
This role will strengthen our project and client management capability as we deliver current and upcoming commitments across APAC. 

About You
We're looking for a Technical Design Manager - Venues & Major Infrastructure to lead complex technology projects across ICT, audiovisual (AV), security, digital infrastructure and venue technology. 
 
You'll guide projects from initial requirements and programming through design, documentation, construction, commissioning and handover. Working closely with clients, consultants, vendors, contractors and technical teams, you'll bring people and disciplines together to deliver coordinated, practical technology solutions. 
 
This role will strengthen our project and client management capability as we deliver current and upcoming commitments across APAC. 

You'll Bring
  • At least five years' experience managing technology design and/or delivery projects in venues, major infrastructure or complex built environments. 
  • A strong understanding of ICT, AV, security, digital infrastructure and systems integration principles. 
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary designs, technical documentation and interfaces with building services. 
  • Proven project management skills across programmes, budgets, risks, scope and change control. 
  • Strong communication and relationship management skills, with experience working with clients, consultants, vendors and contractors. 
  • Experience supporting construction delivery, testing, commissioning and operational handover. 
  • Confidence using project planning and documentation tools such as MS Project or Smartsheet, Microsoft 365 and Bluebeam. Familiarity with CAD/BIM coordination workflows is desirable. 
  • A relevant qualification in Engineering, ICT, Construction Management or Project Management, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Willingness to travel and obtain any required construction site accreditation or inductions.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead technology projects from initial briefing and programming through design, construction and handover. 
  • Work with clients and stakeholders to define requirements, scope, priorities and delivery milestones. 
  • Coordinate design across ICT, AV, security, digital infrastructure and venue systems, drawing on specialist technical expertise. 
  • Oversee drawings, specifications, schedules and tender documentation, ensuring designs are coordinated and suitable for delivery. 
  • Manage project programmes, budgets, risks and changes, providing clear reporting and timely escalation. 
  • Build strong client relationships and coordinate consultants, vendors, contractors and internal technical teams. 
  • Manage construction phase coordination, including site meetings, contractor submissions, technical queries and design changes. 
  • Oversee quality reviews, testing, commissioning, defects resolution and operational handover. 
  • Contribute to proposals, project scoping and improvements to design and delivery processes. 
  • Support safe design and delivery in line with PMY policies and applicable workplace health and safety requirements.


EMPOWERING LIVE
Our client is a global provider of technology, data and creative solutions for the live environment. Across APAC, the USA and EMEA, they partner with clients in sports, entertainment, venues, education, retail and public infrastructure to deliver impactful, end-to-end solutions.

Combining global expertise with deep local insight, we deliver strategy, design, implementation, operations, software, data and fan experience solutions that help organisations operate smarter and create exceptional live experiences.

They're driven by collaboration, creativity and innovation, with more than 450 team members supporting over 1,000 clients across 15 countries.


Why?
  • Work on high-profile stadium, venue, major event and infrastructure projects.
  • Contribute to complex, technology-rich environments where your designs have a visible operational impact.
  • Join a multidisciplinary team with deep expertise across technology, engineering and live experiences.
  • Enjoy a flexible and supportive working environment.
  • Access opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Be part of a collaborative, creative and passionate global team.
  • Receive a competitive salary and employee benefits.
Inclusion & Belonging
Our client is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive. Through initiatives including our RAP Committee, we continue to support reconciliation, inclusion and meaningful community impact across our business and industry.
